command.text: Fresh session used the agent profile; completed setup with income split $105,000/$26,000, aggregate balances split equally ($6,000 cash/$9,500 TFSA/$21,000 RRSP each), same-pay growth, 2% inflation, 5% investment return, age 65 stop-work, default salary-based CPP/OAS estimates. Expenses entered as one $5,600/month total because brief includes the $680 vehicle payment; did not add a separate duplicate debt cost. Overtime and part-time variability are not modeled separately in setup salary; yearly salary overrides are the available approximation. January was open, closed once, and lesson persisted through navigation/reload and export/import. Backup preview showed Jordan & Riley, 1 regular expense, 1 goal; imported and confirmed lesson.
